notes: Partial: Water Safety Ireland prints a split by setting only for accidental drownings pooled over 2019-2023, not for a single year, and 63.5% of those deaths were coded to an unspecified location. Definition: the split covers accidental drownings only; suicide (33.3%) and assault or undetermined intent (1.8%) are counted separately. The page names several bases: its 'Drowning Statistics' section says the information is collated from the Irish Coast Guard, An Garda Siochana, coroners and media reports; the table's footnote calls 2024 and 2025 provisional Central Statistics Office data; and its 2019-2023 county figures are drawn from CSO tables VSA35 (2019-2022) and VSA29 (2023). It does not say which basis the 2019-2023 split uses, though 'coded to' suggests death-registration coding. Water transport (boating) is a separate group, so it is included. Two different totals for the same year sit on the page: the headline 'Total drownings 2024: 78' (and 2025: 80, subject to change) against the table's provisional 2024 total of 105 (90 accidental). The page does not explain the difference; both are left for the reviewer and neither is changed here. No figures were summed; the five-year total is the page's own.
